ItemID: NA; Title: Andrea BCLI BST O A Bocelli; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in familiar pop and rock collections right now than a Bocelli collection.
ItemID: NA; Title: Elvis 30 #1 Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: This fits my interest in older hits and compilations such as AM Gold and Now Classic Rock Hits.
ItemID: NA; Title: When I Fall In Love; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not tell me enough about the performer or songs to choose it this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Songs You Know by Heart : Jimmy Buffett's Greatest Hit s; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A collection of relaxed, familiar songs appeals to my interest in older singer-songwriters and greatest hits.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Best Of Sade; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am leaning toward older rock and holiday music today, so this is less compelling right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Oscd-Nkc - The Christmas Song; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The Christmas theme fits my recent interest in A Very Special Christmas, and I would try it for seasonal listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Time-Life Treasury of Christmas; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: A holiday compilation fits both my recent Christmas listening and my repeated interest in collections.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best Of Daryl Hall & John Oates; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Their pop-rock hits fit comfortably with my interest in The Cars and classic rock compilations.
ItemID: NA; Title: Patsy Cline - The Definitive Collection; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: An older hits collection has some appeal, but I do not feel a strong enough pull toward her music today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Enjoy The Ride; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without a performer or track listing, I cannot connect this confidently to the music I have been choosing.
